rules.content:
title: Session Cookie Exfiltration Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects session token and cookie theft patterns in log data indicative of infostealer activity. Stealers like Lumma and Raccoon target browser cookie stores to extract active session tokens, enabling 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection_cookie_db:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\Cookies"
            - "\\cookies.sqlite"
            - "\\Network\\Cookies"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_process:
        process_name|endswith:
            - ".exe"
        process_signed: false
    filter_browsers:
        process_name|endswith:
            - "\\chrome.exe"
            - "\\firefox.exe"
            - "\\msedge.exe"
            - "\\brave.exe"
    condition: (selection_cookie_db and selection_process) and not filter_browsers
level: high
rules.title: DL-0003: Session Cookie Exfiltration Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Browser Credential Store Access
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual access to browser credential stores (Login Data, logins.json, key3.db/key4.db) by non-browser processes. Infostealers such as RedLine and Vidar systematically read these SQLite databas
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection:
        file_path|endswith:
            - "\\Login Data"
            - "\\Login Data-journal"
            - "\\logins.json"
            - "\\key4.db"
            - "\\key3.db"
            - "\\signons.sqlite"
        file_access_type|contains:
            - "read"
            - "open"
    filter_browser_processes:
        process_name|endswith:
            - "\\chrome.exe"
            - "\\firefox.exe"
            - "\\msedge.exe"
            - "\\brave.exe"
            - "\\opera.exe"
            - "\\vivaldi.exe"
    filter_av:
        process_name|contains:
            - "antivirus"
            - "defender"
            - "security"
    condition: selection and not filter_browser_processes and not filter_av
level: high
rules.title: DL-0004: Browser Credential Store Access (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Stealer C2 Beacon Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects command-and-control callback patterns typical of Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) stealers. RedLine, Lumma, and StealC use distinctive C2 communication patterns including HTTP POST requests with ba
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: web_proxy
detection:
    selection_method:
        http_method: "POST"
    selection_uri_pattern:
        url_path|contains:
            - "/gate.php"
            - "/index.php?id="
            - "/panel/gate"
            - "/api/check"
            - "/loader/"
    selection_payload:
        request_body_length|gte: 5000
        content_type|contains: "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
    selection_domain_age:
        domain_age_days|lte: 30
    condition: selection_method and (selection_uri_pattern or (selection_payload and selection_domain_age))
level: high
rules.title: DL-0005: Stealer C2 Beacon Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:

            - "ACH_DEBIT"
            - "ACH_CREDIT"

rules.content:
title: MFA Method Downgrade
status: experimental
description: Detects when an account's MFA method is changed from a strong phishing-resistant factor (FIDO2/WebAuthn, hardware token, authenticator app) to a weaker method (SMS OTP, voice call). Attackers who comp
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: identity_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "mfa_method_change"
            - "mfa_update"
            - "authenticator_change"
    selection_downgrade:
        previous_mfa_method|contains:
            - "fido2"
            - "webauthn"
            - "hardware_token"
            - "authenticator_app"
            - "totp"
        new_mfa_method|contains:
            - "sms"
            - "voice"
            - "email"
    condition: selection and selection_downgrade
